display.title: Tu B'Av: The Happiest Day and the Custom to Learn More Torah
display.summary_short: Why the fifteenth of Av is one of the happiest days of the Jewish year, and the custom to add more time for Torah learning from this day on.
display.summary_long: A short holiday talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given on the night of Chamisha Asar B'Av. Uncle Yossi explains that we are in the middle of the month of Av, and that the Mishnah says Israel never had days as festive as the fifteenth of Av, when many happy things happened to the Jewish people. Each year we recall those joyous events and pray that Hashem bring such days again in our time. Our Sages recommend a special custom for this day: to add time to Torah learning, by day and especially at night, and to continue throughout the coming winter. For soldiers of Tzivos Hashem this means adding a bit to daily learning, which makes Hashem happy and brings His blessings, and helping friends learn too.
display.lesson: From Tu B'Av on, add a little more Torah learning every day, and help your friends do the same.
